crossRefs.note: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
“Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

translations.web: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
translations.bsb: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
translations.kjv: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
translations.asv: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.
